title: PAANI：面向河流机器人仿真的端侧视觉证据融合与可解释引导
summary: PAANI 是一种端侧感知到引导架构，在 Arduino UNO Q 上结合 YOLO11n 检测器与 MobileNetV3-Small 语义分割器，通过时间戳对齐的证据融合与显式走廊策略生成可解释的导航建议，并通过 ROS 2 连接 Gazebo 仿真测试平台。
summary_en: PAANI is an on-device perception-to-guidance architecture combining a YOLO11n detector and MobileNetV3-Small semantic segmenter with timestamp-aligned evidence fusion on Arduino UNO Q, producing inspectable advisories via an explicit corridor policy and connecting to a Gazebo testbed through ROS 2.
